Google ends all support for the @google/generative-ai package, including bug fixes, on 2025-11-30 and recommends @google/genai, whose call shapes differ. Google does not say that requests through the old package stop working. The README in its last npm release (0.24.1) gave 2025-08-31; the repository README now gives 2025-11-30.

Slack stops executing Steps from Apps on 2024-09-12, so the methods a step calls to report its outcome or update its configuration no longer have a step to act on. @slack/web-api 8 removes all three methods and names no replacement.

Slack's planned sunset date for the files.upload Web API method. Slack's Node SDK guide recommends filesUploadV2, which calls files.getUploadURLExternal and files.completeUploadExternal; @slack/web-api 8 removes files.upload.

Cloudflare's OpenAPI document marks these operations deprecated, end of life 2021-03-01 (x-cfDeprecation zone_analytics_deprecation): Please use the new GraphQL Analytics API instead: https://developers.cloudflare.com/analytics/graphql-api/. Cloudflare's OpenAPI document marks these operations deprecated, end of life 2026-10-01 (x-cfDeprecation opcr_v1_deprecation): Use the v2 endpoints under `/zones/{zone_id}/origin/cloud_regions` instead. The v2 API uses idempotent PUT semantics for create+update, provides a flat response shape, and is the supported path for Terraform and SDK clients. The v1 endpoints under `/zones/{zone_id}/cache/origin_cloud_regions` will be removed on 2026-10-01.

Cloudflare's OpenAPI document marks these operations deprecated, end of life 2026-07-19 (x-cfDeprecation origin_pqe_deprecation): Origin post-quantum encryption selection is now handled automatically by Auto-Origin TLS KEX (`/zones/{zone_id}/settings/auto_origin_tls_kex`) combined with Origin TLS Compliance Modes (`/zones/{zone_id}/settings/origin_tls_compliance_modes`). As that rollout proceeds, the manual `origin_post_quantum_encryption` setting becomes ineffective and the endpoint will be removed on 2026-07-19.

GitHub supports a REST API version for at least 24 months after the next version is released; 2022-11-28 ends support on 2028-03-10, after version 2026-03-10. Requests that pin an unsupported version through X-GitHub-Api-Version get 410 Gone, and requests without the header use the oldest supported version, so they move too. Version 2026-03-10 has breaking changes to listed endpoints.

GitHub’s OpenAPI description marks the source imports endpoints under /repos/{owner}/{repo}/import deprecated (deprecation date 2023-10-12) with a removal date of 2024-04-12. 8 operations.

Auth0 deprecated v6 of the auth0 (node-auth0) package: its npm deprecation notice says v6 no longer receives updates, and that v7 is Management API only, with the authentication clients moved to @auth0/auth0-auth-js and @auth0/auth0-server-js. The notice gives no date; the date here is when v7.0.0 was published on npm.
deadlines.replacement: auth0 v7 (Management API) with @auth0/auth0-auth-js or @auth0/auth0-server-js for authentication

deadlines.summary: Clerk ended support for @clerk/clerk-sdk-node on 2025-01-10, as announced in its October 2024 deprecation notice. Express apps move to @clerk/express.

Clerk's long term support schedule lists Core 1 and the Legacy (v3) SDKs as Unsupported: no changes of any kind. The schedule gives no end date. A previous major gets one year of long term support after the next major ships, and the Core 2 majors were published on npm on 2024-04-19, so the date here is 2025-04-19. The Core 1 majors are the ones Clerk's Core 2 upgrade guides tell you to update to first (@clerk/nextjs@4, @clerk/backend@0, @clerk/remix@3 and so on); @clerk/edge is deprecated on npm in favour of @clerk/backend.
Clerk no longer supports @clerk/elements, per its npm deprecation notice, which points to the Core 3 release of 2026-03-03.

Clerk's Core 2 SDKs are in long term support (critical patches only) until January 2027, then unsupported; the schedule gives the month only, so the date here is its first day. Core 2 majors are the ones published from 2024-04-19 until the Core 3 majors on 2026-03-03 (npm release dates); Clerk's Core 3 guide names @clerk/nextjs@6 as the latest Core 2 release. @clerk/clerk-react, @clerk/clerk-expo and @clerk/types were replaced in Core 3 by @clerk/react, @clerk/expo and @clerk/shared/types, and @clerk/remix by @clerk/react-router.

Firebase Dynamic Links is deprecated and will be shut down as early as August 2025, according to the Firebase JS SDK reference for ActionCodeSettings.dynamicLinkDomain; the page gives no day, so the date here is the first of the month. Auth email links set ActionCodeSettings.linkDomain instead. The markers are that option, the Dynamic Links REST host and the React Native Firebase Dynamic Links module.

Supabase deprecated every @supabase/auth-helpers-* package in favour of @supabase/ssr; the repository README says they are no longer maintained. The deprecation notice was added to that README on 2024-11-27.

Supabase is deprecating the legacy anon and service_role API keys by the end of 2026, in favour of publishable (sb_publishable_…) and secret (sb_secret_…) keys. The markers are the environment variable names that carry the legacy keys (also with NEXT_PUBLIC_ or VITE_ prefixes); a variable with that name may already hold a new key, so check its value.

Auth.js releases security updates only for the current latest version and does not maintain old releases. next-auth's latest major is 4 (v5 is still a beta), so v3 and older receive no updates. The policy gives no date; the date here is when the last v3 release, 3.29.10, was published on npm.

Adyen no longer supports version 3.x of @adyen/adyen-web (Drop-in and Components) after October 1, 2025, per the npm deprecation notice on every 3.x release; the adyen-web README lists 3.x as end-of-life since October 2025.

Adyen no longer supports version 4.x of @adyen/adyen-web (Drop-in and Components) after August 1, 2026, per the npm deprecation notice on every 4.x release; the adyen-web README lists 4.x as end-of-life since August 2026.
Braintree's client SDK table lists braintree-web 2.x as Unsupported since February 2023 (deprecated February 2022). The table gives the month only, so the date here is its first day.
Braintree's server SDK table lists the braintree Node.js SDK 2.x as unsupported from September 2023 (deprecated September 2022). The table gives the month only, so the date here is its first day.
Coinbase marks coinbase-commerce-node as not actively maintained, in its README (notice added 2021-06-10) and in the npm deprecation notice on every release.

EasyPost's upgrade guide marks @easypost/api v5, v6 and v7 as deprecated; older majors predate them. It gives no dates; the date here is when v8.0.0 was released (CHANGELOG), the latest any of these became deprecated.

The AWS SDK for JavaScript v2 (aws-sdk) reached end of support on 2025-09-08 and no longer receives updates or releases. AWS recommends v3, whose modular @aws-sdk/client-* packages have different call shapes. AWS does not say that requests through v2 stop working.

Microsoft lists these 108 legacy (track 1) Azure SDK for JavaScript packages as deprecated with end of life on 2023-03-31: no further fixes or updates. Each has a modern @azure/* replacement named in data/azure-sdk-retirements.json, with different call shapes. Microsoft does not say that requests through the old packages stop working.
deadlines.replacement: The @azure/* package Microsoft names for each (data/azure-sdk-retirements.json)

deadlines.summary: twilio-node 5.x and older get no more features, bug fixes or security updates once 6.0.0 is current: Twilio supports only the current major version of twilio-node (VERSIONS.md, https://github.com/twilio/twilio-node/blob/main/VERSIONS.md). 2026-04-20 is the 6.0.0 release date in UPGRADE.md, not a date Twilio gives for the end of 5.x support. Twilio says 6.x has no breaking API changes but needs Node.js 20 or newer. Twilio does not say that requests through older versions stop working.
